title: CRM Lead
description:
The Role:

We're looking for a commercially minded and data-driven CRM Lead to become Agria's subject matter expert for CRM, performance insight and marketing automation.

This is an exciting opportunity to take ownership of how Agria's CRM priorities are delivered, driving the development, optimisation and performance of our customer communications programmes. You'll play a key role in ensuring customer data, segmentation, reporting and marketing automation are used effectively to deliver commercial growth, enhance customer value and improve customer outcomes.

Combining strategic thinking with hands-on technical delivery, the CRM Lead will play a pivotal role in shaping Agria's customer marketing capability, using data, insight and automation to enhance customer engagement, improve performance and deliver continuous improvement across the customer lifecycle.

As the CRM Lead, you'll own CRM planning, CRM and campaign performance insight, reporting frameworks, marketing automation and data governance, while providing expert guidance on customer targeting, performance optimisation and emerging CRM technologies.

What You'll Be Doing:

CRM Planning & Delivery
- Define, develop and optimise customer lifecycle programmes, ensuring communications are relevant, timely and aligned to customer needs and business objectives.
- Own the planning, development and continuous improvement of Agria's CRM, segmentation and marketing automation capability, translating agreed priorities and briefs into the delivery approach.
- Translate business objectives into data-led CRM plans that drive customer acquisition, retention and lifetime value.
- Lead testing, targeting and personalisation strategies to improve customer outcomes and commercial performance.
- Proactively identify and pitch evidence-based CRM opportunities for approval, then take ownership of implementation.

Insight, Analytics & Reporting
- Own CRM and campaign performance reporting, insight generation and measurement, supporting agreed activity within the wider Customer Marketing insight remit.
- Analyse customer, campaign and commercial data, turning insights into actionable recommendations.
- Identify opportunities to improve customer engagement, retention and overall business performance.
- Develop reporting frameworks that support informed decision-making and measurable business outcomes.

CRM Technology & Automation
- Lead the effective utilisation and development of FastStats, PeopleStage and associated CRM technologies.
- Personally build complex audience selections, customer segmentations, campaigns and automated journeys and reporting outputs.
- Drive continuous improvements in CRM processes, data quality and technical capability.
- Stay informed of emerging CRM technologies, automation tools and AI-driven solutions, identifying opportunities to enhance performance and customer outcomes.

Partner & Stakeholder Management
- Manage and prioritise Agria's retained marketing automation resource, deciding what should be delivered internally and what should be briefed to the agency, ensuring high-quality delivery, efficiency and innovation.
- Act as the key CRM link between Marketing, IT, Data, Compliance and external suppliers.
- Lead CRM-related projects, translating business requirements into effective technical solutions.
- Collaborate across multiple teams to deliver customer-focused marketing initiatives and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For:

We're looking for an experienced CRM professional who combines strong analytical capability with strategic thinking and hands-on delivery experience.

You'll bring:
- Significant experience in CRM, database marketing, customer analytics or marketing automation roles.
- Advanced knowledge of customer segmentation, audience management and data-driven marketing.
- Strong mathematical, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex datasets and identify commercial opportunities.
- Proven experience translating analysis into strategic recommendations and measurable business actions.
- Hands-on experience personally building segments, audiences, campaigns and automated journeys using CRM and marketing automation platforms.
- Experience with Apteco FastStats and PeopleStage would be advantageous, although full training will be provided.
- Experience managing external agencies, technology partners and suppliers.
- Experience working closely with IT and MI teams to deliver customer marketing solutions.
- Strong commercial awareness and accountability for delivering measurable business outcomes.
- A growth mindset and genuine interest in emerging technologies, AI and automation, with a desire to apply innovation to deliver both commercial and Consumer Duty outcomes.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to turn complex analysis into clear, concise recommendations for senior stakeholders.
- The ability to work towards agreed performance targets and deliver results.
- A versatile and adaptable approach, with the ability to respond quickly to the changing needs of a rapidly developing business.

What we offer:
- 25 days annual leave which increases with service, plus bank holidays and an extra day off for your Birthday!
- Opportunity to buy/sell up to 5 days annual leave per calendar year
- Pension and Life Assurance scheme
- Access to 25% off insuring your pet with Agria. Friends and family are also entitled to a discount too
- We aim to support the health and wellbeing of all our colleagues so you'll have access to a Health Cash Plan, mental health support and health and wellbeing platforms, including Headspace

Please note, we operate a hybrid working model, with colleagues attending our Aylesbury office every Wednesday and working remotely for the remainder of the week.

title: EMEA Senior Brand Manager Growth Platforms (M/F)

EMEA Senior Brand Manager Growth Platforms (M/F)

- Working closely with our Insights & Analytics team you will turn datapoints and research into insights and insights into actions, to identify category innovation and renovation opportunities across the EMEA region
- Drive NPD & renovation post evaluations with actionable insights & build learnings into future plans
- Sharing best practices in EMEA region and Global Ecosystem
- Build and deliver regular business presentations to key stakeholders and senior leaders across local markets, the regional and global teams.

Strategy & Plans:

- Lead the development & delivery of innovation and renovation through all stage Gates, gaining continued stakeholder alignment as you do so, whilst working with key functions from ideation through to execution & Go to Market
- Input into the preparation of Quarterly Global Innovation Updates to Senior Leadership teams

Commercial:

- Contribute to the product life cycle management, driving efficiencies through simplification

Team and personal leadership:
- Act as a member of a team of 3 and collaborate based on the priorities set up by the MM
- Manage workload and priorities balancing priorities if needed in collaboration with the MM
- Balance short term priorities with longer term deliverables
- Demonstrate active listening and collaboration with key stakeholders across the business and ultimately determining the right action plans; influencing teams where needed to bring them on board with the priorities and plans

CANDIDATE PROFILE
- Proven track record: successful experience working within FMCG Innovation & Brand-Building at the relevant level
- Curious, data-driven & analytical: you will excel working with the likes of Nielsen, Kantar, Google Trends and Ad hoc research to perform analysis & turn insights into actions
- Full mix marketing: Ideally someone with experience beyond Innovation and Renovation; meaning they are able to understand the overall picture and influence of the various marketing levers and the role I&R can play within this
- Consumer-Centric: you will naturally place the consumer at the heart of everything you do & will excel at driving insight from market research & trends data, be comfortable working with a variety of research methodologies and a multitude of agencies
- Expertise in NPD and renovation: Excellence in NPD development, execution & portfolio management, influencing and collaborating to drive what's needed to grow against a clear category vision
- A sense of ownership: you'll see your area as your own business & love to roll up your sleeves & get stuck into building & leading your platform & brands growth
- Prioritisation: Strong project leadership experience of managing multiple projects & strong ability to prioritise when and where needed
- Cross-Functional team player: building strong relationships across departments within EMEA, you'll naturally take everyone with you & work as one team to deliver against one common goal
- Positive, can-do spirit: you'll bring bags of energy & enthusiasm to driving your platform growth
- Entrepreneurial mindset & ability to challenge the status quo: acting like an owner you will identify new challenges and tackle them in innovative and lateral ways, striving to push boundaries and build transformational thinking on your portfolio
- Passion for food: ideally someone who is a "foodie" and always looking for their next inspiration

title: International Marketing Operations Manager
description:
International Marketing Operations Manager

Job Type: Temporary
Location: Marlow (hybrid working available)
Duration: 12 months

We are seeking an experienced International Marketing Operations Manager to lead and optimise promotional review processes across international markets. This role will act as a key partner to marketing, medical, legal, regulatory and compliance stakeholders, ensuring the efficient review, approval and management of promotional materials for pharmaceutical and/or medical device products. The successful candidate will combine strong project management expertise with a thorough understanding of MLR processes, compliance requirements and promotional review systems to drive operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead and facilitate cross-functional Medical, Legal and Regulatory (MLR) review meetings, managing agendas, stakeholder feedback and approval workflows.
- Manage promotional review activities for assigned brands, ensuring materials progress efficiently through review and approval stages.
- Act as a subject matter expert for promotional review processes and systems, supporting users and driving adherence to company procedures and industry regulations.
- Collaborate closely with marketing, medical, regulatory, compliance and operational teams to ensure timely preparation, submission and approval of promotional materials.
- Lead process improvement initiatives and special projects to enhance review efficiency, materials management and operational effectiveness.
- Analyse process performance, identify opportunities for innovation and support wider Marketing Operations projects and business initiatives.

Skills, Experience & Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification, with a minimum of 5 years' experience within pharmaceutical, healthcare or life sciences marketing operations.
- Strong understanding of MLR review processes, promotional compliance requirements and pharmaceutical advertising regulations, including ABPI guidance.
- Experience working with promotional review platforms such as Veeva PromoMats or similar content management and approval systems.
- Demonstrated project management experience with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver to tight deadlines.
- Excellent stakeholder management, communication and meeting facilitation skills with experience working across international cross-functional teams.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Outlook, with the ability to analyse data and produce clear business communications.

What's on Offer

This is an excellent opportunity to join a highly collaborative global organisation, where you will play a pivotal role in driving compliant promotional excellence, influencing international stakeholders and leading initiatives that improve marketing operations across multiple markets.

Marketing and Content Coordinator

Location: Milton Keynes, Buckinghamshire

Salary: 26,000 - 28,000 Pro Rata (2 days per week)

- Create engaging content for social media, websites, email campaigns and other digital platforms.

- Design graphics and social media assets using Canva, Adobe or similar creative software.
- Attend live events, rehearsals, production builds and other activities to gather behind-the-scenes content.

Digital Marketing and Campaigns

- Develop and coordinate targeted email marketing and digital campaigns.
- Monitor social media performance, website traffic and campaign engagement.

Collaboration and Event Content
- Work closely with production, projects, design and operational teams to identify marketing opportunities.
- Attend events and project locations to capture authentic content.
- Coordinate photography, filming and interviews with colleagues, clients and venues.

Essential Requirements
- Previous experience in marketing, content creation, digital marketing or communications.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including strong copywriting and proofreading abilities.
- Experience creating engaging content for social media and digital platforms.
- Practical experience using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or similar design software.
- A full UK driving licence and valid passport.

Desirable Experience
- Previous marketing experience within live events, event production, creative agencies or a B2 B environment.
- Experience producing marketing content at live events.
- Knowledge of website content management and SEO best practices.
- Experience developing email marketing campaigns.
- Familiarity with CRM systems and supporting new business development activity.
- Experience producing case studies, client presentations or promotional materials.

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys marketing and content creation, rather than simply managing social media accounts.

You will be naturally curious, confident in communicating with different teams and comfortable taking ownership of projects from initial ideas through to delivery.

The ideal candidate will be creative enough to spot a great content opportunity, organised enough to deliver it on time and commercially aware enough to understand how marketing contributes to business growth.

An interest in live events, production, design or the wider creative industries would be particularly beneficial.

What's on Offer?

- Direct involvement in shaping the company's marketing activities and digital presence.
- Close collaboration with senior management and creative production teams.
- Opportunities to develop your experience across marketing strategy, content production and business development.

title: Marketing Coordinator
company: Bucks and Berks Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Are you a commercially minded Marketing Executive looking for a role where you can make a real impact and develop your career?

We're working with an established UK business based in Buckingham looking to appoint a proactive, hands-on Marketing Executive to take ownership of its day-to-day marketing activity, while playing an increasingly important role in shaping its wider marketing direction.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys the practical side of marketing but is equally interested in understanding customers, markets and commercial objectives. There is genuine scope for the successful individual to develop into a broader, more senior marketing position over the coming years.

About the Company - Marketing Executive

Our client is an established UK manufacturer operating within a specialist technical product market, supplying customers through a network of trade partners, merchants and installers.

With exciting opportunities for growth and plenty of untapped potential within its marketing function, the business is looking for someone who can bring fresh ideas, take ownership and help develop its marketing approach for the future.

About the Role - Marketing Executive

Reporting to the Managing Director, you'll take responsibility for delivering a broad range of marketing activity, working closely with internal teams, particularly Sales, alongside external creative and digital suppliers.

Responsibilities will include:
- Planning and delivering marketing campaigns, product launches and promotional activity aligned with commercial objectives.
- Managing social media, creating content, writing marketing copy and maintaining the company website through WordPress.
- Developing email campaigns, managing marketing databases and monitoring campaign performance.
- Coordinating trade shows, exhibitions, video content and marketing materials for merchants, distributors and trade partners.
- Briefing and managing external creative suppliers, ensuring projects are delivered effectively and within budget.
- Working with Sales to understand customer needs, identify opportunities and use market and campaign insight to improve marketing activity.

Importantly, this isn't simply a marketing execution role. As you develop your understanding of the products, customers and markets, you'll have increasing involvement in campaign planning, customer insight, product positioning and wider marketing strategy, with the opportunity to grow into a more senior position over time.

About You

We're looking for someone who is proactive, commercially aware and naturally curious about how marketing can contribute to business growth.

You'll ideally have:
- Experience in a hands-on marketing role, with strong digital marketing and campaign management skills.
- Good working knowledge of social media, email marketing and WordPress.
- Strong copywriting skills and experience creating marketing content and basic creative assets using Canva or similar.
- An analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret data and use insight to make practical recommendations.
- Confidence working with different teams, managing external suppliers and taking ownership of projects.
- The ambition to develop beyond day-to-day marketing delivery and take on greater strategic responsibility.

Experience within manufacturing, engineering, construction, building services or trade/merchant-led environments would be advantageous, but isn't essential. A full UK driving licence and regular access to a car are essential, as some external travel will be required. This is an office-based position, so due to the location of the Buckinghamshire office, this role is commutable from Milton Keynes, Leighton Buzzard, Brackley, Bicester, Buckingham, Towcester, Aylesbury, Northampton and Olney.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Job Description

Reporting to the Head of Marketing, the Marketing Manager will play a key role in delivering marketing activities and campaigns across Connells Group's core brands, including Sales, Lettings and Auctions.

The role is responsible for managing the day-to-day planning, execution, optimisation and reporting of integrated marketing activity that supports lead generation, brand awareness, customer engagement and commercial growth. Working collaboratively with stakeholders across the business, the Marketing Manager will ensure campaigns are delivered effectively, aligned to business objectives and achieve measurable results.

This is a commercially focused role requiring strong project management, stakeholder engagement and analytical skills, with responsibility for managing campaigns, budgets, suppliers and marketing performance across multiple brands and channels.

The role will also support the delivery of internal communications that enhance stakeholder engagement, promote strategic initiatives, drive colleague awareness and understanding, and ensure alignment between Marketing and key business functions.

Key Responsibilities:

Campaign Planning & Delivery
- Lead the planning, coordination and delivery of integrated marketing campaigns across multiple brands and business areas.
- Manage campaign execution across digital, print, social, email, PR, branch and local marketing channels.
- Coordinate marketing support for new initiatives, product launches, acquisitions, branch activity and business change programmes.

Performance & Commercial Delivery
- Monitor, analyse and report on campaign performance, providing recommendations to improve effectiveness and ROI.
- Support lead generation and customer acquisition activity across Sales, Lettings and Auctions.
- Use customer, market and campaign insights to identify opportunities and drive continuous improvement.

Stakeholder Management
- Build strong working relationships with stakeholders across Sales, Lettings, Auctions, Operations and Group Marketing.

Budget & Supplier Management
- Support the management and tracking of budgets across campaigns and projects.

Team & Collaboration
- Support the development of the marketing team through coaching, guidance and knowledge sharing.

- Support the Head of Marketing in delivering departmental objectives and strategic priorities.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience:

title: Social Media Executive - Field Based, Various Locations
description:

title: Trustee - Communications, Marketing and PR
description:
Communications, Marketing & PR Trustee (voluntary)

Location: Aston Sandford, Bucks HP17 8 JB with travel across Thames Valley and occasionally further afield

Time Commitment: 5-6 days Per Year

Hope After Harm is a Buckinghamshire based registered Charity and Charitable Company Limited by Guarantee of 32 years' operating a range of support programmes across the Thames Valley - including support for victims, support for the families of offenders, early interventions, work in the field of domestic abuse and support to offenders. With 40 staff and approximately 30 volunteers, a solid Trustee framework is essential to underpin and inform our work and our Trustees currently bring together considerable experience from criminal justice, local government, the corporate and voluntary sectors.

We have a very exciting vacancy we wish to fill, to complement our existing Board and guide our successful and growing organisation into the next phase of development. This is an opportunity to use your professional skills to support a charity delivering meaningful impact across the Thames Valley.

Hope After Harm is relatively small, trustees can see the direct results of their contribution and frontline impact, we require general Trustee experience, to expand the knowledge base and help strengthen the Board overall, we are also specifically looking for those with experience in the following areas:

For the Marketing, Communications and PR Trustee position, your role will be:
- Advise the Board on communications, media, marketing and reputation matters.
- Provide strategic oversight of Hope After Harm's brand, profile and public positioning.
- Offer constructive challenge on communications risks, including reputation, safeguarding, confidentiality and data protection.
- Support the Board to consider how communications can strengthen awareness, stakeholder confidence, fundraising and community engagement.
- Provide guidance on the charity's approach to public statements, media interest and crisis communications.
- Champion communications that are sensitive to the experiences of survivors, families, young people and others affected by harm and trauma.
- Work with the CEO and staff team in an advisory capacity to support effective delivery

Person specification

The trustee should bring senior-level knowledge or experience across a number of the following areas:
- Public relations, media relations and strategic communications
- Brand management and brand consistency
- Crisis communications and reputation management
- Stakeholder engagement and public engagement
- Social media strategy and digital communications
- Content development across online and offline channels
- Awareness campaigns and community outreach
- Communications governance, including tone of voice, messaging and reputational risk

The successful candidate does not need to be an expert in every area, but should be able to provide strategic insight, constructive challenge and proportionate assurance to support the charity's work.

Time Commitment

The Trustee will be expected to attend Board Meetings 4 times a year (face to face) and also attend one committee meeting (Teams) 4 times a year, as well as attending a strategy day. The time commitment including meeting preparation is estimated to be 5-6 days per annum

Location

Ideally, the post-holder will be able to travel to Aston Sandford and possibly other places in the Thames Valley for meetings, but we would consider remote attendance, with the exception of a requirement for face-to-face attendance at the annual Board strategy day

If you have a passion and commitment to support a value-driven organisation, strategic vision, independent judgement and a willingness to devote the necessary time and effort we would be delighted to hear from you. Any travel and out of pocket expenses will be reimbursed but please note this is a voluntary and unpaid post.

Please email covering letter expressing your interest, with a CV of your skills.
